# README introduction videos

These are selected, unchanged exports from the local `videos/` projects. The MP4 exports are uploaded as v0.3.1 Release assets and ignored by Git to keep binary revisions out of source history. Posters remain in ../assets/.

| Documentation asset | Source export |
| --- | --- |
| `ambleloft-intro-en.mp4` | `videos/ambleloft-intro-en/renders/ambleloft-intro-en-v3.mp4` |
| `ambleloft-intro-zh-CN.mp4` | `videos/ambleloft-intro-zh/renders/ambleloft-intro-zh-v2.mp4` |

Both videos are 80 seconds, 1920 × 1080, H.264, 30 fps, with burned-in localized captions and no audio. The English v3 and Chinese v2 exports present the same content in their respective languages. Their different export version numbers do not indicate different content editions.

`../assets/intro-en.png` and `intro-zh-CN.png` are frames extracted at 32.5 seconds from these exports. The `extension-platform-*.png` images are the existing 54-second presentation frames from each project's v2 render set.

The recordings use the real frontend with synthetic data and a simulated desktop bridge. They demonstrate collecting information and returning it to chat, not live model execution or a production reimbursement submission. The video uses a two-step UI fixture; the independent extension sample demonstrates a separate three-step workflow with a local demo service.

README images link to the MP4 assets on GitHub Release v0.3.1. They do not rely on GitHub accepting an embedded HTML video player.
